title: Priya Waited 20 Minutes for One Latte

scenes.say: Her ticket got stuck behind a big order. Nobody noticed. Twenty minutes on the rail.
Roma Tom walked it over himself. I'm so sorry, Priya. That one's on us, and so is tomorrow's.

props.name: Roma Tom
props.quote: So sorry. This one's on us, *and tomorrow's*.

scenes.speaker: Priya
scenes.say: I came back the next day just to see. Now I come every day.

props.name: Priya
props.quote: Came back to see. Now I come *every day*.

scenes.say: So: small orders jump the line. Call out anything over five minutes. And when you miss one, walk it over yourself.
